title: Up in the Air
description: A corporate downsizing expert (George Clooney) realizes he is developing real feelings for a frequent bedmate (Vera Farmiga) whose cache of travel miles and club cards rivals his own.

title: Quantum of Solace
description: James Bond's (Daniel Craig) hunt for those responsible for Vesper Lynd's death leads him to a ruthless businessman (Mathieu Amalric) who is plotting to seize control of a valuable resource.

title: Argo
description: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

title: Sleepless
description: An undercover Las Vegas police officer (Jamie Foxx) must race against time to save his kidnapped son (Octavius J. Johnson) from a crew of murderous gangsters.

title: Se7en
description: A meticulous detective and the young officer about to replace the veteran probe serial murders based on the seven deadly sins.

title: Dexter: Resurrection
description:
S02 E03 — Live Free and Die
Dexter closes in on a ruthless killer terrorizing the city, but a fleeting clue is all he has to go on; as Harrison settles into his new role at NYPD Homicide, mounting pressure, old rivals and dangerous suspects threaten to derail the hunt.

title: It Gets Worse
description:
S01 E05 — Stop All The Cocks
Ethan, Abi and Sam attend a funeral for an old friend from university; the funeral brings their love and loneliness to the surface; Abi reflects on her relationship with Tom; Ethan pursues Aaron; and Sam wrestles with her guilt.

title: It Gets Worse
description:
S01 E06 — People Team
Ethan, Abi and Sam attempt to reconcile, but the new chapter only reveals that their messy lives are far from resolved; surely it gets better than this, right? But who needs better, when they have each other?

title: Office Christmas Party
description: Hoping to close a sale and save their jobs, two co-workers (Jason Bateman, T.J. Miller) must rally their colleagues to throw an epic Christmas party.

title: Bad Santa 2
description: Fueled by cheap whiskey and greed, a foulmouthed criminal (Billy Bob Thornton), his mean mother (Kathy Bates) and their angry sidekick (Tony Cox) conspire to bilk a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve.

title: A Bad Moms Christmas
description: As if creating the perfect Christmas for their families isn't hard enough, under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla will have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers during the holidays.

title: Furlough
description: When an inmate is granted one weekend of freedom to see her dying mother, a rookie correction officer struggles to keep her under control.

title: Fist Fight
description: Fired from his teaching job for losing his cool, a disgruntled man (Ice Cube) challenges the colleague (Charlie Day) who snitched on him to a fight after school.

title: Baby Driver
description: Coerced into working for a crime boss, a talented getaway driver must face the music when a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

title: Gravity
description: The destruction of their shuttle leaves two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone and Matt Kowalski, stranded in space with no hope of rescue.

title: Patriot Games
description: An IRA terrorist vows revenge against the ex-CIA agent who killed the man's brother and thwarted an attack on royalty.

title: V for Vendetta
description: After world war leads to a fascist government, a vigilante known as V (Hugo Weaving) uses terrorist tactics to fight the totalitarian state in which he now lives.

title: Apocalypse Now Redux
description: An Army agent (Martin Sheen) goes upriver into the heart of Cambodia to kill a renegade colonel (Marlon Brando).

title: Godzilla
description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.

title: Twister
description: Storm-chasers (Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton) finalizing their divorce try to place equipment inside a tornado on the Oklahoma plains.

title: Saving Private Ryan
description: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

title: Pike River
description: On Nov. 19, 2010, a coal mine explosion in New Zealand kills Anna Osborne's husband and Sonya Rockhouse's son, along with 27 other men. The two women soon embark on a quest for truth and justice, leading to change they never thought possible.
